jobs.title: Event Security Officers – Level II & Level III
jobs.description:
We are seeking professional, dependable, and experienced security officers to support event operations alongside event staff, venue security, local law enforcement.

Positions Available

  • Level II Non-Commissioned Security Officers
  • Level III Commissioned Security Officers

Level II Non-Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level II Officers will provide professional, uniformed security support throughout the event. Officers will primarily be assigned to access-control, observation, guest-flow, and security-presence posts.

Responsibilities

  • Staff assigned security posts, including entrances, interior doorways, stairwells, corridors, registration areas, and other designated locations.
  • Maintain a professional and visible security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for unauthorized access, disturbances, suspicious activity, safety concerns, or violations of event policies.
  • Assist with orderly guest movement and crowd flow.
  • Provide basic directions and assistance to guests when appropriate.
  • Report security incidents or concerns through the established chain of command.
  • Assist event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement personnel as directed.
  • Respond appropriately to disturbances, safety concerns, or medical incidents until relieved by emergency personnel.
  • Remain at your assigned post unless properly relieved or directed otherwise.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Important: Event personnel, not Level II officers, will have primary responsibility for validating invitations and checking guest identification.

Level II Requirements

  • Current Texas DPS Non-Commissioned Security Officer (Level II) license, or higher applicable Texas security license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation with RKSMS through the Texas Online Private Security system prior to the event.
  • Must have completed all required Texas training and licensing requirements.
  • Level II officers will not carry firearms while performing security duties.
  • Professional appearance and conduct.
  • Strong communication and situational-awareness skills.
  • Ability to remain standing and attentive for extended periods.

Level III Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level III Officers will provide armed security coverage at strategically designated locations throughout the event. Officers will supplement Level II personnel and support areas requiring an elevated security presence and rapid-response capability.

Responsibilities

  • Staff designated armed-security posts at higher-risk or strategically important locations.
  • Maintain a professional and highly visible armed-security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for threats, disturbances, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, and safety concerns.
  • Provide immediate security response when directed by event leadership.
  • Assist with de-escalation and management of security incidents within the officer's authority and training.
  • Coordinate with event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement when necessary.
  • Maintain strict firearms safety, weapons-retention, and use-of-force discipline.
  • Remain at the assigned post unless properly relieved or redirected.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Level III Requirements

  • Current and active Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer (Level III) license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation prior to the event.
  • Completion of required Level III training, testing, and firearms qualification.
  • Must meet all applicable Texas DPS firearms requirements.
  • Must be qualified with the type/category of firearm authorized for use at the event.
  • Strong situational awareness, communication, and professional judgment.
  • Ability to remain attentive and professional in a large, high-profile event environment.

Ideal Candidates

We are looking for security professionals who are:

  • Licensed and in good standing with Texas DPS.
  • Reliable and punctual.
  • Professional and customer-service oriented.
  • Comfortable working in a large-scale event environment.
  • Able to follow post orders and the established chain of command.
  • Experienced with crowd management, access control, event security, or similar assignments.

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

Job Description

Job Description

Now Hiring: Level 3 Armed Security Officers for Overnights & Weekends

Join a Trusted Name in Texas Security – 20+ Years Strong

Verified Response Security & Investigations (VRSI) is growing, and we’re seeking dedicated, professional Level 3 Commissioned Officers to join our team in both full-time and part-time roles.

If you\'re passionate about community safety and professionalism, we want to hear from you.

️ About Us

For over two decades, VRSI has been a respected name in Texas security. Our officers don’t just work posts—they make an impact. We take pride in providing highly trained, reliable professionals to serve and protect our communities with integrity.

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Multiple shifts available: evenings, overnights, weekends
  • Positions are primarily in multi-family residential communities
  • Flexibility is key—we appreciate and reward reliability

Responsibilities

Officers will be responsible for:

  • Enforcing community rules and curfew policies
  • Responding to service calls and reporting maintenance issues
  • Supporting local law enforcement and emergency services during incidents
  • Maintaining a strong and visible security presence

Requirements

To be considered, applicants must have:

  • A valid Level 3 Pocket Card
  • At least 1 year of verifiable experience
  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Personal vehicle (public transportation not accepted)
  • Working smartphone
  • Ability to pass a background check and drug screening
  • Required duty gear, including:
  1. Firearm (.38 cal or higher)
  2. Level 3 holster
  3. Two extra magazines
  4. OC spray (with current certification)
  5. Handcuffs and flashlight

Perks include:

  • Paid holidays (1.5x pay rate)
  • Paid vacation after 12 months
  • Complimentary ASSIST membership with benefits:
    • $10,000 AD&D policy
    • Free Telehealth access
    • Discounted US Law Shield coverage
  • Flexible schedules and referral bonuses

Apply Today

Ready to serve with one of Texas’s most trusted security companies?
We look forward to meeting you.

Company Description
About Verified Response Security & Investigations (VRS&I)
At Verified Response Security & Investigations, we proudly serve the Dallas-Fort Worth community with comprehensive, professional security solutions tailored to diverse needs. As a full-service firm, we offer:
- Commissioned Security Officers
- Vehicle Patrol Services
- Alarm Response

What sets us apart is our unmatched ability to match the right officer to the right assignment. From multi-family communities and commercial properties to individual clients requiring personal protection, we approach every assignment with precision, purpose, and professionalism.

Our growing reputation as a leader in the Texas security industry is rooted in two things: our dedication to client satisfaction and our commitment to employee retention. At VRSI, we don’t just provide security—we build trust through consistency, integrity, and unwavering responsiveness.

jobs.title: Security Officer Level III
jobs.description:
As a Certified Armed Security Officer, your primary responsibility will be to maintain a safe and secure environment for the students and staff at various elementary schools within the ISD.

Ensure the safety of students, staff, and visitors on the premises.

Conduct regular patrols and maintain constant vigilance of the premises.

Respond to emergencies quickly and professionally, escalating to local law enforcement as necessary.

Detect suspicious activities and manage crowd control during school events and functions.

Utilize security equipment and tools to maintain law and order.

Conduct investigations and prepare incident reports.

Maintain a visible presence to deter unlawful actions.

Assist with evacuations, lock-downs, and other emergency procedures.

Provide first aid assistance as required.

Coordinate with school administration, staff, and local law enforcement agencies.

Comply with all legal and organizational regulations regarding armed security.


Skills:
Educational Administration, Emergency Procedures, Emergency Response, First Aid, Investigative Reports, Law Enforcement, Legal, Reporting Skills, Safety/Work Safety, Security Equipment
